cluster.description: Cluster subchart: the upstream values under cluster.runai-cluster, including the registration values and KAI under cluster.runai-cluster.kai-resource-management.kai-scheduler. See charts/cluster/values.yaml.
cluster.title: cluster

controlplane.description: Control-plane subchart: TLS for global.domain, and the upstream values under controlplane.control-plane. See charts/controlplane/values.yaml.
controlplane.title: controlplane

global.description: additionalProperties: true @schema global._runai configures this chart. Every other global key is passed to the upstream charts, which read e.g. global.domain, global.ingress, global.image and global.config.

enabled.description: Run:ai cluster, including KAI Scheduler. Release namespace must be runai. Needs a running control plane and the values scripts/register_cluster.sh writes.
enabled.title: enabled

controlPlane.description: namespace; values.<profile>.yaml sets the switches for each.

enabled.description: Run:ai control plane. Release namespace must be runai-backend.
enabled.title: enabled

controlPlane.title: controlPlane

certificate.description: PEM CA bundle rendered into the runai-ca-cert Secret of the release namespace when global.customCA.enabled is true. Leave empty to create runai-ca-cert yourself.
certificate.title: certificate

enabled.description: NVIDIA GPU Operator, or the fake GPU operator (gpu.fake-gpu-operator.enabled).
enabled.title: enabled

enabled.description: Standalone KAI Scheduler, without Run:ai. Upstream documents namespace kai-scheduler. Never together with cluster, which bundles KAI.
enabled.title: enabled

mode.description: "auto" lets templates call lookup. Set "install" or "upgrade" when rendering with `helm template` (ArgoCD), where lookup returns nothing.
mode.title: mode

enabled.description: kube-prometheus-stack. The Run:ai cluster requires a Prometheus Operator.
enabled.title: enabled

server.description: Registry host for the control-plane pull secret runai-reg-creds. Nothing is rendered unless server, username and password are all set. The images on nvcr.io/nvidia/runai-oss are public.
server.title: server

enabled.description: Trust the CA in Secret runai-ca-cert (key runai-ca.pem). Needed when the control-plane certificate is not signed by a public CA.
enabled.title: enabled

domain.description: FQDN the control plane is served on. Required by the controlPlane component.
domain.title: domain

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets for control-plane and KAI pods, as [{name: <secret>}]. The Run:ai cluster reads global.additionalImagePullSecrets (a list of names) instead.
imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets

global.title: global

gpu.description: GPU subchart: gpu.gpu-operator and gpu.fake-gpu-operator, each with an enabled switch.
gpu.title: gpu

kai.description: Standalone KAI subchart: the upstream values under kai.kai-scheduler.
kai.title: kai

monitoring.description: Monitoring subchart: the upstream values under monitoring.kube-prometheus-stack.
monitoring.title: monitoring
